title: PPHL final testing round
source: PPHL Leadership letter following Beta 2 review, November 3, 2026
constraints: Engineering rehearsal is separate from PPHL acceptance

cases.task: Create a league and upload the supplied Harbor Hawks PNG. Try an oversized image, then retry with the valid file.
cases.expected: The logo preview and saved league show the uploaded file. An oversized file produces a clear error.

cases.task: Set registration, season and playoff dates in the guided setup; review them together, save a draft, reopen and publish.
cases.expected: Dates retain their meaning and values. Draft registration stays closed until explicit publication. Record total setup time.

cases.task: Use no regular-season overtime and sudden-death playoff overtime. After regular-season results, generate a playoff bracket and open a playoff game's scoresheet.
cases.expected: The playoff rule is separate, saved and used by the game. A tied playoff result cannot be finalized.

cases.task: Leave playoff qualification on All teams, save and reopen the division.
cases.expected: All entered teams qualify without selecting each team individually. The saved summary still says All teams.

cases.task: Configure Adult Open, use Copy Division, name the copy Adult 40+, and change one setting in the copy.
cases.expected: Game/playoff settings copy across. Editing the copy does not change the original.

cases.task: Register Harbor United through the free team tier and review it from the registrar console.
cases.expected: Team registration has no card requirement or automatic non-zero charge. Player registration pricing remains separate.

cases.task: Luca Martinez submits a player registration using cash/cheque, then starts and submits two separate team registrations using the same account.
cases.expected: The offline registration is retained. Each team gets its own record; earlier submissions do not block the next one.

cases.task: Copy a representative season, then roll forward the 70-league scale workspace. Pause, reload and resume.
cases.expected: Selected dates/settings/forms/prices copy correctly. Drafts remain unpublished. Replays create no duplicates; payments, registrations, live rosters and results are not copied.

cases.task: Open the league registration link, sign in, complete details and waivers, submit offline, review from a fresh staff session, then inspect the player's registration and captain's roster.
cases.expected: The same submission appears at every destination with correct name, season, status and team. Signed documents persist.

cases.task: Add a holiday blackout, generate and review the draft, publish, then open both recipient schedules and notification inboxes in fresh sessions.
cases.expected: No holiday games or hard conflicts. Drafts are private; published games and one relevant notice appear for the intended recipients.

cases.task: Use an assigned game, enter a goal and assist, finalize the score, then inspect the result, player statistics and standings.
cases.expected: Permissions match the assigned job. Scores follow events; finalization updates statistics once. Unrelated games and admin data stay inaccessible.

cases.task: Maya submits test ID TESTPPHL01 and uploads the supplied fictional membership proof. Staff review it and confirm its sample expiry. Maya opts into North Metro goalie invitations. Request a substitute, approve the private invitation, accept from Maya's other league and inspect both destinations.
cases.expected: An entered ID alone stays pending. Staff approval uses the proof and leaves an audit trail. No invitation before request approval; no contact/DOB disclosure; eligibility rechecked; one accepted guest. No substitute fee or credit.

cases.task: Attempt the supplied out-of-scope links. Exercise failed-load/retry, refresh recovery and narrow/mobile layouts.
cases.expected: Foreign organization data never appears in the screen or response. Failures are visible and recoverable, without false empty/success states.

cases.task: Create one new season and copy an existing one without live engineering guidance. Note time, questions and wrong turns.
cases.expected: PPHL confirms the workflow is understandable and reduces manual work. Proposed target for discussion: new setup in 10 minutes or less; a copied setup faster.

acceptance: PPHL records Pass, Fail or Blocked for each mandatory case and names the tester.
No unresolved blocker or major defect in an agreed launch workflow.
PPHL explicitly accepts any excluded/deferred feature.
Commercial capacity, live payments and production cutover require separate sign-off.
deferred: Substitute fees, credits and refund rules
